coder_notes: Population includes multiple glioma types (GBM IDH-wt and IDH-mutated, diffuse astrocytoma, DMG H3K27M) per WHO 2016; ages 3-30. IDH and H3K27M rows only define alternative eligible diagnoses (no single molecular entry requirement; IDH-wt and IDH-mutated both allowed) - adjudicator may prefer not to count them as molecular selection. Radiotherapy registered within the Drug intervention but not listed as agent. Doxorubicin is the only investigational agent added to Stupp RT/TMZ backbone.
